_coverage: ⚠️ A structural gap, disclosed rather than papered over. The quote source serves US-listed and OTC ADR securities only; native Hong Kong, Shanghai, Seoul and European listings are refused. So the CHINA names reachable here (Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent, Xiaomi, Kingsoft Cloud) are platform and cloud companies, NOT the domestic chipmakers. SMIC, Hua Hong and Cambricon cannot be shown, and neither can Samsung or SK Hynix. Reading the visible China names as coverage of Chinese AI hardware would be a denominator error of exactly the kind this board flags elsewhere. OTC ADRs are also thinly traded and can lag their home listing, which is noted on each.
